index.html.training.p1: Most people only «watch» AI. A few produce with it — and in a few years those few will take everyone else's place. «AI Journey» is the most comprehensive Turkish-language AI course to date: from prompting and automation to building websites, CRMs and earning income — all on one path, from zero and with no prior knowledge.
index.html.training.p2: Completely project-based — no dry theory, no empty promises; every chapter ends with a real project you can show off the same evening. The instructor produces content in 4 languages; the course videos are in Turkish, support is in English, German, Turkish and Persian.
index.html.chapters.1.text: Time to wake up. The world has changed and you're still working with yesterday's tools. We start from absolute zero: what AI is, how it thinks and how to make it work for you starting today.
index.html.chapters.2.text: Professional prompting — the 20% of skill that produces 80% of the result. The formula of role, context, goal, constraints and output format; so every model gives you exactly what you want.
index.html.chapters.3.text: Automation with n8n. Leave repetitive work to bots: workflows that run 24 hours a day for you — from Instagram DMs to e-mail, the database and the CRM.
index.html.chapters.4.text: Claude from zero to a hundred. Hire Claude Code like a full-time colleague: writing skills, sub-agents and building a custom «brain» for Claude; let your projects move themselves forward.
index.html.chapters.5.text: Producing with code — without fear. Programming languages in plain human language, building a real website, a custom CRM and FYOS: your own personal agentic operating system.
index.html.chapters.6.text: Being seen. Video editing with Claude, the Instagram algorithm, smart DMs, content production, page building and campaigns — run your brand like a growth machine.
index.html.chapters.7.text: The finish line — and the starting line. Here all the skills become the one that earns money: offers, pricing and winning clients; or multiply the revenue of your own business. Climb your summit.

index.html.about.p1: I live in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, and study IT. I started with software only recently; I wanted the notes I took while learning to live somewhere — and those notes became the very path I now show to others.
index.html.about.p2: I've spent the last stretch entirely in the world of AI — building, making mistakes, rebuilding. The result is FY: an agency that builds websites, makes businesses smarter and passes on everything I've learned in the «AI Journey» course.
index.html.about.p3: My belief is simple: the AI wave waits for no one — but if someone shows the way, anyone can ride it. I'm building that way.

index.html.faq.1.a: Yes. The course is fully online: you watch the videos wherever and whenever you like, with your personal access. All 7 chapters are ready; you can start right away.
index.html.faq.2.q: Why do you call it the most comprehensive Turkish-language AI course?
index.html.faq.2.a: Because no other Turkish-language course covers this whole path in one place: professional prompting, automation with n8n, Claude Code from zero to a hundred, skills and a custom «brain», building a real website and CRM, FYOS, video editing with AI, the Instagram algorithm and finally turning all of it into income — 7 chapters, completely project-based; every chapter ends with a real project.
index.html.faq.3.a: Farhad Yaqoobi — the founder of FY. He studies IT in Germany, produces content in four languages and shares what he learns as open-source projects on GitHub — with exactly the methods he teaches in chapter 6.
index.html.faq.4.q: What language is the course in?
index.html.faq.4.a: The course videos are in Turkish. Support and questions in the student portal are answered in English, German, Turkish and Persian. There is no instalment plan; the course is paid in one payment.
index.html.faq.5.a: With enrolment you get 45 days of full support as a gift — you ask your questions in the student portal and get answers. After 45 days, an extension costs 10% of the price you paid for the course.
index.html.faq.6.a: It was designed exactly for that. Chapter 1 starts from absolute zero — no programming knowledge and no prior experience with AI is needed. We go step by step, and every chapter builds on the previous one.
index.html.faq.7.q: What projects will I build in the course?
index.html.faq.7.a: The course is completely project-based: real bots and automations with n8n, skills and a custom brain for Claude, a real website with its own CRM, a personal agentic operating system (FYOS), videos edited with AI and an Instagram content campaign — every chapter ends with a project you can show.

terms.html.terms.title: Terms & Privacy
terms.html.terms.intro: Using the FY website and enrolling in the course means accepting the terms below. This is a convenience translation; the German version is the binding one. Last updated: 3 September 2026.
terms.html.terms.prose:
This English text is provided for convenience. In case of any difference, the German version prevails.

1. What this website collects

  • This website is static: it has no server, no database and no user accounts. Nothing is sent to us when you visit the pages.
  • The contact and application forms open your own e-mail app when you submit; what you write reaches us only when you send that e-mail. You attach your CV yourself.
  • Course enrolment happens by e-mail. We use your name and e-mail address to issue the licence.
  • The student portal page is not yet connected to a working portal and does not ask for a password. Its «notify me» form, like every other form, only opens your e-mail app; your address reaches us only if you send the e-mail.

2. Cookies and browser storage

  • The website sets no cookies. There is no advertising and no third-party tracker.
  • The FYOS chat keeps its daily question counter only in your browser's storage; that number is not sent to us and disappears when you clear your browser data.
  • FYOS answers are generated on your device: on suitable devices, your browser downloads an open-source AI model once at your first question and computes later answers locally. Your questions and the answers are sent neither to us nor to any other server; the model cache disappears with your browser data.

3. External services and hosting

  • Every file of the website, including the font, is loaded from this website. The one exception is the FYOS chat: at your first question your browser downloads the AI library from cdn.jsdelivr.net and the model files from huggingface.co. This download starts only when you ask a question, and only the file request — never your question — goes to those addresses.
  • The website is hosted on GitHub Pages. Like any web server, GitHub may keep access logs; they are subject to GitHub's own privacy policy and are not accessible to us.
  • Your connection to the website is encrypted (HTTPS).

4. What we do with your details

  • Details you send us by e-mail are used only to provide the service you asked for.
  • Your details are never sold or passed on to any third party.
  • You can ask for the deletion of the details you sent us at any time by e-mail.

5. Conditions of the «AI Journey» course

  • The course licence is personal; it is issued to the buyer's name and e-mail address and embedded as a watermark in the videos.
  • Sharing, reselling, publishing or distributing the course content (video, files, text) is prohibited and will be pursued legally; the infringer's licence is cancelled without refund.
  • The course is paid in one payment; instalments are not available.
  • Course support is included for 45 days after enrolment; after that, an extension costs 10% of the course price.

6. Right of withdrawal

This section applies to consumers (§ 13 BGB — people who buy the «AI Journey» course for purposes outside their trade, business or profession). The contract is concluded by e-mail and is therefore a distance contract (§ 312c BGB); the course is digital content not supplied on a tangible medium. If you buy as a business, there is no statutory right of withdrawal. Web design and automation are offered to businesses; if a consumer orders such a service, the withdrawal notice for service contracts is provided separately with the offer. The free 30-minute call does not create a contract.

Withdrawal notice

Right of withdrawal. You have the right to withdraw from this contract within fourteen days without giving any reason. The withdrawal period is fourteen days from the day the contract is concluded. To exercise the right of withdrawal, you must inform us (Farhad Yaqoobi — FY, ⟦street and number⟧, ⟦postcode city⟧, Germany; phone: ⟦phone number⟧; e-mail: JavaScript required to show the e-mail address) of your decision to withdraw from this contract by an unequivocal statement (e.g. a letter sent by post or an e-mail). You may use the model withdrawal form below, but it is not obligatory. To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient for you to send your communication concerning your exercise of the right of withdrawal before the withdrawal period has expired.

Effects of withdrawal. If you withdraw from this contract, we shall reimburse to you all payments received from you, including the costs of delivery (with the exception of the supplementary costs resulting from your choice of a type of delivery other than the least expensive type of standard delivery offered by us), without undue delay and in any event not later than fourteen days from the day on which we are informed about your decision to withdraw from this contract. We will carry out such reimbursement using the same means of payment as you used for the initial transaction, unless you have expressly agreed otherwise; in any event, you will not incur any fees as a result of such reimbursement.

When is the contract concluded and when does the period start?

Enrolment is not made through a «buy» button on the website but by e-mail exchange. The contract is concluded on the day we send you, in reply to your enrolment e-mail, the acceptance of your enrolment with the payment steps; the fourteen-day withdrawal period runs from that day. You also receive this notice and the model form with that e-mail before the contract is concluded, so you have a durable copy.

Early expiry of the right of withdrawal (§ 356 BGB — digital content)

For digital content not supplied on a tangible medium, the right of withdrawal expires before the end of the period once all three conditions are met:

  • you have expressly consented to us beginning performance of the contract before the withdrawal period ends,
  • you have acknowledged that you thereby lose your right of withdrawal,
  • and, before sending the access details, we have provided you with a confirmation of the contract on a durable medium — e-mail is sufficient — that includes your consent and this acknowledgement (§ 312f BGB).

Without your consent, course access is opened only after the fourteen-day withdrawal period has ended; your right of withdrawal remains fully intact during that time. The expiry or lapse of the right of withdrawal does not affect the 45 days of support or lifetime access; in case of withdrawal the contract falls away entirely. Your statutory rights regarding defects in digital content (§§ 327 ff. BGB) apply in any case.

Consent text (in the enrolment e-mail)

If you want immediate access, you confirm it in the enrolment e-mail by writing the following two sentences yourself — a pre-ticked box, a default consent or a mere «ok/yes» does not count:

«I want to access the course content immediately. I expressly consent to performance of the contract for the “AI Journey” course beginning before the withdrawal period has ended.»
«I acknowledge that I lose my right of withdrawal by giving this consent.»

Controller

There is no obligation to appoint a data protection officer. The full provider details are in the Impressum (legal notice).

Purposes and legal bases

  • Contact form and your e-mails. To answer your request and prepare an offer. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — pre-contractual steps; also Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR — our legitimate interest in answering enquiries.
  • Course enrolment, licence and invoice. Name, e-mail and payment details to issue the licence, open access, provide support and issue the invoice. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — performance of the contract; for invoice data Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR — statutory retention duty.
  • Job application (CV). To evaluate your application. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR and § 26 BDSG (German Federal Data Protection Act).
  • Student portal notification list. Only your e-mail address, to notify you when the portal opens. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR — your consent; you can withdraw it at any time by e-mail without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.
  • Hosting access logs. The website is hosted on GitHub Pages; GitHub, Inc. (San Francisco, USA) may, like any web server, process access data such as IP address, time and requested file under its own responsibility and privacy policy. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR — secure and stable operation of the website. The contracting party for users in the EU is GitHub B.V. (Amsterdam); the safeguards for transfers to the USA (Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses) are described in GitHub's privacy statement.
  • Local model files for FYOS. Only when you ask the first question in the chat and your device is suitable, your browser downloads the AI library from jsDelivr (cdn.jsdelivr.net) and the model files from Hugging Face (huggingface.co). Only an ordinary file request (IP address, browser information) goes to those providers — not your question. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR — our interest in running the chat serverless on your device. The counter in browser storage is strictly necessary for a function you expressly requested and needs no consent (§ 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG).

When the chat is connected to a real model

Currently switched off. On the day it is activated this section will be updated and the following will apply: to count your daily question quota, your IP address is stored in Cloudflare KV until the end of the day; your question and at most the six previous messages are sent to Anthropic, PBC (USA) or Cloudflare Workers AI to generate the answer. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR; third-country transfers are safeguarded by standard contractual clauses under Art. 46 GDPR.

Retention

  • Contact and offer e-mails: until the request is settled; if no contract is concluded, deleted after six months at the latest.
  • Course contract, licence and invoice records: ten years under tax law (§ 147 AO, § 257 HGB).
  • Job applications: deleted no later than six months after the process ends; longer storage only with your consent.
  • Notification list: until you withdraw your consent.

Your rights

  • Access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18) and data portability (Art. 20).
  • Objection (Art. 21): you may object at any time, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)).
  • Withdrawal of consent (Art. 7(3)): for processing based on consent, with effect for the future.
